accountTypes.title: Delta Chat
accountTypes.provider: Any email address, or a new one on a chatmail server
accountTypes.summary: Chat over email, end-to-end encrypted by Delta Chat's own core: one-to-one chats and groups in Messaging, pictures included, read receipts both ways, and the people you chat with in Contacts. Needs Delta Chat's core in the system image.

privacy.dataGoesTo: your email provider (or the chatmail server), encrypted end to end between Delta Chat users
